title: This is the easiest way to force Claude to write ad copy that actually sounds human.
description:
This is the easiest way to force Claude to write ad copy that actually sounds human.

Everyone can smell AI copy now. The stiff rhythm, the buzzwords, the "in today's fast paced world." It tanks your conversions.

So here is the fix. Go to Google, type "Wikipedia AI text signs," grab that URL, and tell Claude to turn it into a skill for writing ad copy that won't get flagged as AI.

Then I load it up with Fable 5 and Ultra Code mode, spin up agents that build in every ad copy framework I actually use, and have sub agents verify the output passes as human written.

Drag the finished skill into Claude, type /human ad copy skill, and it spits out five variations I can drop straight into my primary text.

Comment HUMAN and I'll send you my free guide to set this all up. As a bonus I'll include my actual skill, preloaded with all my ad copy frameworks, so you don't burn through your own tokens building it.
